summary: ITERATION 4 — Security-fix regression pass, backend only. 16/16 tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes_iter4.py, covering all 3 CVEs + enumeration fix + regressions. SEC-001 (no source-default creds): backend boots (GET /api/ 200 with app=GymBuddy,status=ok,1306 exercises), login with OLD default 'AdminGym2026!' for admin@gymbuddy.app now correctly returns 401, rotated password 'GbpILMEvPcKRGzK9ZG!7' returns 200 with role=admin & root_admin=false. SEC-002 (promote root-only): as regular admin PATCH /api/admin/users/{uid}/role action=promote returns 403 (DB confirms role unchanged); as regular admin action=demote returns 403 on a root-pre-promoted admin (DB confirms still admin); as ROOT both promote and demote return 200 and flip role in DB. SEC-003 (token invalidation on pw change): fresh user token A verified with /api/auth/me (200); after ROOT POST /api/admin/users/{uid}/password, /api/auth/me on token A now returns 401 as required. Reset-password happy path: forgot-password -> planted bcrypt code_hash in password_resets -> /api/auth/reset-password returns {token,user}, the NEW token WORKS on /api/auth/me (200, correct email), OLD pre-reset token is REJECTED (401), and login with new pw works. Enumeration fix: /api/auth/forgot-password for root email 'myscraptv@gmail.com' returns 200 {ok:true} (NOT 403) and NO password_resets record is created for root (verified via pymongo); unknown email also 200 {ok:true}; existing non-root user 200 {ok:true} AND a password_resets record with bcrypt code_hash + attempts=0 is created. Emergent Resend integration still delivering: backend log shows 'POST https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted' triggered by forgot-password for delivered@resend.dev. Regressions: root+regular admin login both 200; GET /api/admin/overview 200 for both; DELETE /api/admin/users/{uid} regular admin 403, root 200 with DB user row purged; PUT /api/admin/users/{uid} regular admin 403, root 200 with name updated in response; DELETE /api/users/me hard-purges user + measurements (verified in DB); PUT /api/users/me with {role:'admin', root_admin:true} in body — Pydantic drops the unknown fields, response has role!=admin & root_admin false, DB confirms no escalation (ProfileUpdate mass-assignment block holds).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1205-1222 admin_change_role — promote now correctly gated behind admin.get('root_admin') and returns 403 'Only the head admin can grant admin rights.' Demote likewise root-only. Regular admin remains able to hit the endpoint (require_admin) but is blocked at the branch level, so the non-role paths (disable, list, overview) still work for them. Correct SEC-002 fix.

server.py:102-118 get_current_user — the pw_changed_at invariant uses strict '<' comparison, so a token whose iat equals pw_changed_at (same second, as happens on /auth/reset-password where make_token is called AFTER the users.update_one) is NOT wrongly invalidated. Verified end-to-end that the reset-password response token immediately works on /auth/me while the pre-reset token is rejected. Good.

server.py:1249-1257 admin_set_password — sits behind Depends(require_root), still 403s when a non-self root target is passed, and correctly sets password_hash + pw_changed_at=int(now_utc().timestamp()). Old tokens for the target become 401 instantly. Correct SEC-003 fix.

server.py:336-356 forgot_password — always returns {ok:True} (no 403 branch anymore); root is filtered by `user and not user.get('root_admin')` so root simply doesn't get a reset row nor a send_email call. Confirmed via DB check that no password_resets doc is created for the root email. Correct enumeration fix.

backend/.env — JWT_SECRET, ROOT_ADMIN_EMAIL, ROOT_ADMIN_PASSWORD all present. ROOT_ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env is 'GbBF2dDiBOJzU0MtwenpYsCw!9' but per code that value is only used to seed a brand-new root (not existing accounts); actual root pw remains RootPass123 as documented. Health endpoint (GET /api/) 200. SEC-001 fix intact.

ProfileUpdate (server.py:211-228) has no `role` / `root_admin` fields, and PUT /api/users/me / POST /api/users/me/onboarding both build $set from model_dump(exclude_none=True). Pydantic default extra='ignore' means unknown role/root_admin body fields are silently dropped — mass-assignment block confirmed at runtime.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral users prefixed test_<slug>_<uuid>@example.com were registered and purged inside each test (either by DELETE /users/me or by root DELETE /admin/users/{uid}). One transient password_resets doc for delivered@resend.dev remains from the Resend-verification curl at the end; safe to leave (auto-expires in 15 min).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Root: myscraptv@gmail.com / RootPass123 (root_admin=true). Regular admin: admin@gymbuddy.app / GbpILMEvPcKRGzK9ZG!7 (root_admin=false, role=admin — DID NOT get demoted this iteration; kept intact). Reusable pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes_iter4.py — uses pymongo + bcrypt to plant a known code hash for the reset happy-path test; caches root token in a module-level dict to stay under the in-memory per-email login rate_limit of 10/60s (do NOT run this suite with -n>0 / xdist parallelism because rate_limit is per-worker but the server it hits is single — run with `-n 0`). Note: backend has hot-reload enabled (`WatchFiles detected changes ... Reloading`), so editing files under /app/backend/ during a test run will bounce the server; write test files first then execute.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all three security fixes work as designed; no bugs found. Two initial test failures were self-inflicted: (1) tests generated 'TEST_' upper-cased emails while the server stores/queries in lower-case, so mongo lookups by mixed-case email missed the record — fixed by lower-casing the local part in the fixture; (2) pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` which caused per-email login rate_limit (10/60s in-memory) to trip on root re-logins — fixed by caching the root token module-level and running the suite with `-n 0` (documented in context_for_next_testing_agent).
